title: Sort by your own rule
description:
Write `void sortByLength(std::vector<std::string>& words)` that sorts shortest first. Words of the same length go in alphabetical order.

Pass `std::sort` a lambda that takes two words and answers one question: "should `a` come before `b`?"
hints: The lambda compares two words. If their lengths differ, the shorter comes first: `return a.length() < b.length();`. If the lengths are equal, fall back to `return a < b;` (alphabetical).
